newsitem.title: UK: LME copper nudges lower in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper nudges lower in late trading.

text.p: LME copper prices dipped slightly in late inter-office trading on Wednesday after a putting in a weak performance in ring activity.
At 1900 GMT three month prices were indicated at $2,330/4 per tonne, down from a kerb close of $2,338.
Chartists say a bearish outside day pointed to more vulnerability to the downside, where $2,313 forms the top of a gap extending down to $2,288.
Other metals prices were little changed to a touch weaker in late activity.
